mentions.name: g2ngine
mentions.description: A visual editor for creating video games that runs in the browser and on Linux desktop. Features undo/redo via a stack of swappable states, serialization to disk (native) and LocalStorage (web), and loading of OBJ, GLTF, and GLB models as type-level distinct 'blueprint scenes' with newtype entity IDs. Work in progress includes alpha rendering, depth sorting, a multi-shader material system, physics, and JavaScript scripting on web (in-browser) and desktop (via the Boa JS runtime).
